title: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit Part 4/5: Extraction 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load deck with required labware
steps.instruction: Place an Abgene Midi plate on the magnetic module in slot 11, a chilled PCR plate on the temperature module in slot 3, and set up two 12‑channel reservoirs as shown in the setup diagram.

steps.title: Map sample wells to elution plate
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample well directly: magnetic extraction plate well A1 → elution PCR plate well A1, B1 → B1, …, D2 → D2, preserving the same well coordinates.

steps.title: Configure tip parking options
steps.instruction: Set ‘park tips’ to yes (recommended) so tips are stored in the empty rack well matching each sample well; optionally set ‘track tips across protocol runs’ to yes to retain tip‑rack state between runs.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map, matching the labware positions described above.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App for all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; use the provided calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Execute extraction workflow
steps.instruction: Perform the three main extraction steps in order:

substeps.instruction: Add binding buffer to each sample.
Wash beads twice using the magnetic module.
Elute DNA to the chilled PCR plate.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to begin the automated extraction.
